environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Define config/environment variables once, per environment, and reference them from node fields with {{$env.KEY}}. Values are non-secret; secrets stay in Credentials.
environments.empty: No environments yet. Create one to define reusable config variables.
environments.no_credentials: No credentials — add one in Credentials
environments.error_key_duplicate: Duplicate variable key '{{key}}' — keys must be unique.
environments.picker_subflow_unassigned: This subflow has no environment assigned — assign one in Environments → Assign.
environments.picker_dynamic_placeholder: Drag an id from the Input tab, or type {{ ... }}
environments.picker_dynamic_hint: Resolved at run time to an environment id — must be one of this sub-flow's assigned ids (a name/label is not accepted).
environments.picker_dynamic_warn_literal: Not an assigned environment id of this sub-flow — it may still resolve at run time.
environments.assign_description: Bind a workflow to one section and choose which of its environments the run-time picker may use.
environments.assign_pick_workflow: Select a workflow to configure its environment binding.
environments.assign_no_sections: No sections yet. Create environments in Config first.
environments.assign_pick_section: Pick a section to choose its environments.
environments.assign_min_one_warning: At least one environment must stay selected.
environments.assign_save_error: Could not save the environment assignment.
environments.select_unassigned_hint: No environment assigned — configure in Environments → Assign
environments.config_intro: Sections group environments that share one variable key schema. Define keys once per section; every environment supplies its own value.
environments.no_sections: No sections yet. Click "Add section" to define a shared variable schema.
environments.section_name_hint: A section groups environments that share one variable key schema.
environments.delete_section_confirm: Delete section "{{name}}" with its {{variables}} key(s) and {{environments}} environment(s)? This removes the shared schema and every environment's values, and cannot be undone.
environments.no_shared_variables: No variables yet — click "Add variable" to define the section's shared keys.
environments.variable_key_hint: Applies to every environment in this section.
environments.variable_key_invalid: Use letters, digits and underscore; must not start with a digit.
environments.variable_key_exists: Key "{{key}}" already exists in this section.
environments.variable_existing_hint: Reuses the key with its existing type, so the same variable stays consistent across sections.
environments.variable_existing_empty: No keys from other sections are available to reuse. Switch to Create new.
environments.variable_existing_required: Select a variable key to add.
environments.key_duplicate_hint: Duplicate or empty key — keys must be unique and non-empty in this section.
environments.keys_invalid_client: Fix the highlighted key(s) — keys must be unique and non-empty.
environments.keys_invalid_server: The server rejected these keys — see the highlighted field(s).
environments.schema_save_error: Could not save the variable schema.
environments.select_environment: Select an environment to edit its values.
environments.environment_inherit_hint: Inherits all {{count}} key(s) of the section (empty values to fill in).
environments.environment_name_exists: Environment "{{name}}" already exists in this section.
environments.delete_environment_confirm: Delete environment "{{name}}" from {{section}}? Its values are dropped; the shared keys stay.
environments.values_hint: Every environment carries the same keys — fill in {{name}}'s values.
environments.no_keys_add_first: This section has no keys yet — add variables first.
environments.section_rename_exists: A section with that name already exists
environments.flat_intro: Environments are first-class here — independent of any section. Each holds its own KEY → value variables. Add an environment to one or more sections in the Sections tab.
environments.flat_hint: An environment can be a member of several sections at once (its section memberships are shown as chips).
environments.flat_add_environment_hint: Add it to sections afterwards to inherit their keys.
environments.flat_no_section: No section — add it in the Sections tab
environments.flat_keys_readonly: Keys are not created here — they come from the shared schema of each section this environment belongs to. You only fill in the value.
environments.flat_no_keys: This environment isn't in any section yet, so it has no keys. Add it to a section to inherit that section's shared key schema.
environments.flat_type_conflict: A key is defined with different types across this environment's sections. A key must keep the same type in every section (422 KEY_TYPE_CONFLICT) — resolve it in the Sections tab.
environments.sections_intro: A section groups the environments a family of workflows may run against. Attach any number of environments to a section — and the same environment may sit in more than one section.
environments.membership_count: {{selected}} of {{total}} selected · tick to add / untick to remove
environments.membership_save_error: Could not save the section membership.
environments.membership_key_conflict: Key "{{key}}" is {{typeA}} in {{sectionA}} but {{typeB}} in {{sectionB}} — a key must have the same type in every section (422 KEY_TYPE_CONFLICT).
environments.section_workflows_hint: All of them can use every environment above at run time. A parent and its sub-flow bound here always share the same set — no mismatch.
environments.bind_intro: A workflow binds to exactly one section. There is no per-flow environment selection — at run time it may use any environment of the bound section.
environments.bind_save_error: Could not save the section binding.
environments.bind_preview_empty: Bind a section to make environments available.
environments.bind_preview_section_empty: This section has no environments yet.
environments.bind_preview_count: Every environment of the bound section — no manual per-flow picking ({{count}}).
environments.bind_calls_subflows_hint: Because they share the same section, each sub-flow automatically has the same environments — the old "environment not assigned on the sub-flow" error can't happen.
